exposure: Anastatica hierochuntica aqueous extracts (AHAE) at doses of 250, 500, and 1000 mg/kg
cohort: The study included pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats and their developing foetuses.
finding: The highest (1000 mg/kg) and lowest (250 mg/kg) doses of A. hierochuntica aqueous extracts showed prenatal toxicity effects in Sprague-Dawley rats, leading to reduced maternal weight gain, lower foetal body weight, increased anogenital distance index, and multiple congenital anomalies, while the 500 mg/kg dose showed no significant adverse effects.
gest_age: Treatment administered from gestational day 6 (GD6) to 20 (GD20); caesarean section performed on GD21
